goals: Verify that the BUTTER function correctly applies a highpass filter to an input signal to remove its DC offset.
activities: Generate x and y data arrays representing a sine wave with an offset
Assert that the mean of the generated y values is between 0.9 and 1.1
Initialize an OrderedPair object with the generated x and y data
Execute the BUTTER highpass filter function on the OrderedPair with specified filter parameters
Assert that the mean of the resulting filtered y values is close to 0
